meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Emacs 中与 AI 对话，无需外部服务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 Emacs 并想直接在编辑器里与 AI 交互
copy.tagline_en: Chat with AI inside Emacs, no external service needed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Emacs and want to interact with AI directly from your editor

howto.what: 装上后，你可以在Emacs里直接和Claude聊天，也能把org文件里的段落发给它，回复会以子标题形式嵌在原文下方。
howto.when: 当你在Emacs里用快捷键（如 C-c n c）打开聊天窗口，或对org内容执行发送命令（如 C-c n o）时触发。

say.text: 这段代码哪里可能出错了？
say.note: 在聊天窗口里提问，回复会显示在其中。

say.text: 帮我把这段改成更正式的语气。
say.note: 选中org文字发送，回复作为子标题插入。

say.text: 从这些议程里提取行动项。
say.note: 发送会议议程，会收到列表形式的回复。

howto.what_en: Once installed, you can chat with Claude directly inside Emacs and send org-mode sections to it; replies appear as child headings in your org file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you open the chat buffer using a keybinding (e.g. C-c n c) or send org content with a command like C-c n o.

say_en.text: Where might this code go wrong?
say_en.note: Ask in the chat buffer; the reply appears there.

say_en.text: Rewrite this in a more formal tone.
say_en.note: Send selected org text; the reply inserts as a child heading.

say_en.text: Extract action items from these agenda entries.
say_en.note: Send agenda text; you get a list back.
